sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Andrew C. Burdine.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Andrew C. Burdine worked for the Utah Department of Corrections’ Adult Probation and Parole division from July 13, 2015, through November 1, 2019. He worked for the American Fork Police Department from November 4, 2019, through August 16, 2022. A professional profile for Burdine lists subsequent private-sector employment with Wheeler Technology.
